# AutoHotkey 2.0.31 (bundled)

`AutoHotkey64.exe` is the unmodified official binary from
https://www.autohotkey.com/download/2.0/AutoHotkey_2.0.31.zip
(zip SHA-256 `ca1a595aca4528755d8d4cd7fed23d497a37bd9a0b6892072612d68dee1bd00a`, verified against the published `.sha256`).

AutoHotkey is licensed under the GNU GPL v2 (`license.txt`). Source code: https://github.com/AutoHotkey/AutoHotkey (tag `v2.0.31`).
Mac Keymap runs it as a separate program with a generated script; it is not linked into Mac Keymap.
